correctness.rationale: Smoothness follows from derivatives of sigma3 modulo sigma1. Explicit projective S5 stabilizers yield five disjoint orbits totaling 145, and 15+12 explicitly constructed contained lines exhaust 27 by Cayley-Salmon; a split cubic over F9 has exactly 9^2+7*9+1=145 points. The 120-permutation line incidence certificate and independent 9^4-coordinate exhaustive census both succeeded with standard-library arithmetic. Limits: only F9.

value.rationale: A complete arithmetic symmetry stratification on the unique characteristic-three Clebsch diagonal surface in its smallest split field determines all point stabilizer types and their incidence with all 27 lines, distinguishes two order-4 stabilizers at identical orbit size, and shows every rational point is involution-fixed. These natural data are not implied by the previously known coarser point count, group order and Eckardt counts. The exact finite field is intrinsically motivated, not an arbitrary parameter.
